biotools.summary: Plans geometric serial dilution series for molecular biology and biochemistry workflows, rounding transfer volumes to declared pipette ranges and optional 96- or 384-well plate layouts. A browser calculator supports interactive protocol design; a Python client and command-line tool submit the same parameters to the Pepkio Tools API for scripted and pipeline use. Calculator arithmetic is hosted remotely; the client transmits parameters and returns structured step tables and shareable run identifiers.

credit.name: Pepkio
credit.note: Pepkio develops software tools and bioinformatics solutions for life science researchers, including laboratory calculators and analysis services.

function.note: Web calculator for bench planning; Python library and CLI for API-backed automation of the same dilution engine.
